card.name: Scattered spots in cell-therapy and fertility text
card.fires_on: Small connecting marks or words (a space after 'is', a dash in a test list, 'of', '(') in passages on cell-therapy infusion labels, or on fertility and pregnancy testing. Also partway through the name RETHYMIC.

modes.label: Infusion dose and label numbering
modes.description: A space or number marker in cell-infusion label text, such as dose figures and section numbers.
modes.example: The minimum recommended dose is<< >>7 x 10 6 CD

modes.label: Dashes in fertility test lists
modes.description: The dash bullet in a list of tests for infertility in women.

modes.label: Pregnancy testing phrases
modes.description: A small linking word or bracket in sentences about prenatal tests or fetal stage.
modes.example: If your baby is small, ultrasound exams may be done more often than usual to check your baby's health. One test<< is>> fetal monitoring.
